provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games)

modules.name: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows
modules.note: Modular: turn on the parts you want below.

modules.name: FP&CS: Corruption tiles, Minions, Corrupted Elemental
FP&CS: Rotting Fly and Worm cards
FP&CS: Faer Rituals and the Pegasus

steps.text: Pick a Scenario from the Scenario book (first game: The Hunt)
The Scenario's starting Map tile in the middle (usually the Church without a Priest)
Rotunda starting tile in the middle instead of the Church one (only in Scenarios that use the Church without a Priest)
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Rotunda

steps.text: Return the Church with the Priest tile (Chapter I) to the box unless the Scenario uses it
Sort the other Map tiles by Chapter (back numeral), then by arrow type: Fixed, Encounter, Scenario, Other
Fixed tiles: use either the base set or the expansion set, never mixed
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Fixed Map Tiles

steps.text: Shuffle the Corruption tiles into the Other tiles of Chapters II-IV
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Corruption Map Tiles

steps.text: Shuffle the new Encounter tiles into the Encounter tiles of Chapters I-III; their Encounter cards into the Encounter pile
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Encounters

steps.text: Use all Fixed tiles of each Chapter
Solo: use only the 2 Fixed tiles per Chapter with the one-player icon
Add the Scenario's tiles and the number of facedown Encounter and Other tiles its Map Setup table gives for your player count
Shuffle each Chapter facedown; stack them with the highest Chapter at the bottom and Chapter I on top
Faer Rituals: shuffle each used Chapter's Ritual tile into it; Ritual Reward tiles by colour facedown; Ritual card faceup
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Faer Rituals and the Pegasus

steps.text: Each player picks a Hero (Ael, Dral, Keleia, Maeldur, Skoldur, Taesiri) and takes its board and components
steps.note: First time with a Hero: read its Hero sheet

steps.text: Eltrea is also available; she adds a Familiar board with 5 Familiar cards (one Alignment, Leaf or Moon, Will o' Wisp on top), Familiar standees and Wound tokens
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Eltrea

steps.text: Maximum Health token above the highest blood-red slot; a Hero token next to it as current Health
Beside your board: Hero, Action, Trade, Interaction and Damage tokens and your 2 Hero dice
Starting Hero tile(s) faceup on the slot with the matching icon
New Hero tiles (required with Eltrea): add each Hero's 6 expansion tiles; pick 1 of its 2 new Starting tiles to add (Taesiri: see the rulebook)
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Hero Tiles

steps.text: Other Hero tiles facedown, lowest Reputation on top (only those for your player count)
4 Gaar tokens on your Gaar slots; your standee beside the board
Scenario/Trade board aside: random starting player's Hero token on Round 1; everyone's Hero token on Reputation 0; Reputation tokens nearby
Merchant, Alchemist and Dragonslayer tiles: one shuffled facedown stack each above the board, 4 faceup in each column
Healing Potion and Grey Sack tiles beside the board; room below it for discards
Reference sheet nearby; Shii's Intervention card with the Die of Hope beside it on blank
Encounter cards in a pile nearby, ordered by type
Natural Resource and Treasure tiles shuffled facedown in stacks by back
Shuffle the new Treasure tiles into their stacks
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Treasures

steps.text: Monster cards in decks by difficulty, shuffled facedown
New Monster cards: Hard swaps one of the two cards of each Monster, Heroic replaces all 3 decks
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Monster Cards

steps.text: Silver and Gold decks shuffled facedown
steps.note: Leave out one-player-icon cards unless playing solo

steps.text: Silver and Gold: choose 3 types of each (8 cards per type) from base and expansion cards
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Silver and Gold Cards

steps.text: Control cards of the Heroes in play shuffled facedown
Box the Control cards
Nearby: Gem, Gaar, Essence, Chaos, Move and Global Effect tokens, Gold tokens and the Elemental cards faceup
Combat cards back in the box (solo and co-op only)
Minion cards faceup by type with the Reward card (Minion Rewards side up)
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Corruption Map Tiles

steps.text: Corrupted Elemental card, its Global Effect token and the Corrupted Essence tokens nearby
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Corrupted Elemental

steps.text: Map Secrets: pick a Secret card faceup; its Object tokens beside it (shuffle any Bird, Wolf, Bear or Deer tokens)
steps.ref: Fierce Powers & Crawling Shadows rulebook (Steamforged Games), Map Secrets

steps.text: Elite Monsters: per difficulty level take players + 2 random Bounty cards; stack them highest level at the bottom; reveal the top one and its Elite Monster
Solo: 2 dice of another Hero as Monster dice; Combat deck shuffled; swap the Soul Control Gold cards for the one-player ones
steps.note: Playing with Fire and Fellowship modes: see the Fierce Powers rulebook

steps.text: Do the Scenario's own setup
At the start of your first turn, put your Hero on the Church at the centre of the starting tile (or the Rotunda)
Each round: put out 1 Mining, Trade and Combat Action token, ready Items and Abilities, flip Gems active
End of turn: you may keep 1 unused Action token on your 4th slot for next turn
The starting player never changes
The starting player takes the first turn; then clockwise
